name: artie
description: Connect Artie to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Artie MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Artie to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with real-time data pipelines using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Artie workspace.
Find anything in Artie that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review real-time data pipelines in Artie.
